name: Goniometer pointer: J2 is an arc rail running beside the arm's elevation path, no J2 hub
family: spherical 3R with a virtual-axis arc-rail J2
verdict: screened, NOT converged (gate fails on the top-5 spread 5.8 points): best honest gap 102.5 (score 62.7) on Bench(60,160) fast - far behind the spherical 3R champion (68.93) and the verified leaders (rail-elbow 64.7, seed-offset-3r-slides 66.47 on Bench(110,360)). The spec (pointer + C-slide) scores 112.24 (reach 0.46). The arc rail is 0-6 % in band in every honest configuration: replacing a J2 hub by a virtual-axis rail makes J2 worse, not better
limiter: the rail is ONE circle about the virtual axis a2 (a rigid 30-50 deg carriage needs a true circle; the spec's skin-following Rr(phi) is kinematically wrong), so it sits at the worst pose's skin height over its whole 125-150 deg arc: K3 q95 requirement 57 mm at the overhead end vs 137 mm at the rest end (champion axes), 93-150 mm on the spec's pointer; fitted rails 116-173 mm, rail in band <= 0.06 and carriage <= 0.0006 in all 75 honest configs; in 119 of 194 Sobol configs a rail sample has no clearance within 220 mm (its rest end passes through the arm / torso at abduction 60-105, plane -15..60). Spec variant also capped by pointer-cslide's twist window (reach 0.46)
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, K3 march, K2 dense, K6 (+ by-construction bearing pairs), audit clean (honest); best k 0 of 195; GATE NOT passed (2nd-half gain 0.0, last-third gain 0.0, top-5 spread 5.81 score points). Sweep: 1 local + 194 farm Sobol (128 hub-J3 3R, 64 spec C-slide, 2 seeds); 110 entries flagged honest:false after the run (rail parked at the 400 mm fallback; numbers unchanged); CMA-ES from k0 running on the farm (python3 docs/concepts/models/meridian-goniometer.py farmcma '{}' 6 24 0.2 hub), appends to the sweep. Red team (k0): overhead flexion (90,165,-90) hub3 -2.8 / neck -3.7 mm (contact); root 1.7 mm at (0,60,-60); behind-back (-75,30,165) and abduction-ER (-15,75,90) singular (closure margin 8.3 / 1.3 deg); rail nearest skin 8.4 mm at abd 90 / extension, median > 31 mm (beyond the grid) in every pose. Mass 318 g Ti.
